source: Closed-Loop Feedback in CHAP: Step-by-Step Guide (Nov 11, 2026), steps 5-8 and the settings table. The guide's stress is this project's frustration (its stress labels come from the Frustration DBR); its mental load is fatigue.

questions.frustration: Were you feeling frustrated at that time?
questions.fatigue: Were you feeling tired at that time?
questions.selfFrustration: Are you feeling frustrated right now?
questions.selfFatigue: Are you feeling tired right now?

implementationChoices: askLevels is the guide's ASK_STRESS / ASK_LOAD: ask only after a High frustration or High fatigue prediction. Add "medium" to ask more often and learn the middle band.
askSources lists the raw.source values that may trigger a question. The Polar H10 is left out because the guide treats a heart-only signal as research only; its predictions are still counted.
minGapMinutes (MIN_GAP_MIN), the single open question and the expiry apply per session. Self-reports through "How do you feel?" do not start the gap.
maxAgeMinutes (MAX_AGE_MIN) is measured from the predicted moment to the time of asking, so late Empatica uploads are asked about only while the moment is under 30 minutes old.
expireMinutes (EXPIRE_MIN): an unanswered question is saved as "no answer".
littleCountsAs decides whether "A little" counts as felt when agreement is measured; retraining takes its own --little option.
Demo-mode answers are stored and shown, but retraining leaves them out unless --include-demo is given, and then refuses --apply.
